title: Korean-Style Vegan Tofu Bites
description: Crispy fried tofu bites marinated in a sweet and spicy Korean-inspired sauce, perfect as a snack or side dish.
instructions: 2. Cut the tofu into 1-inch cubes and place on a plate.
3. In a shallow dish, mix together cornstarch, chili flakes (if using), and a pinch of salt.
4. Coat each tofu cube in the cornstarch mixture, shaking off excess.
5. In a separate dish, whisk together soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic, and 2 tbsp of water.
6. Add the tofu cubes to the marinade and toss to coat.
7. Heat 1/2 cup of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
8. Fry the tofu cubes in batches until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per side.
9. Using a slotted spoon, remove the fried tofu from the oil and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
10. Bake the tofu in the preheated oven for an additional 10-12 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
11. Serve the Korean-Style Vegan Tofu Bites hot and enjoy!
